svg.title: HTTP request pipeline and authentication
svg.desc: A request passes logRequests, securityHeadersMiddleware, the CORS middleware, authMiddleware, originHostGuardMiddleware and the router. authMiddleware passes public paths, then accepts a session cookie, a Bearer gateway token or a bootstrap ?token=, and otherwise counts a failed attempt on AuthRateLimiter. /mcp, webhooks and /knowledge/source authenticate themselves.

g.text: Hover a box for its role; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Six middlewares in order; authMiddleware checks four credentials, and failed attempts count against one shared limiter.

g.class: e dash f-pub t-mcp t-hooks t-src

g.text: logRequests · shelf request log through a sanitized logger
Only a secret= query value (the WhatsApp webhook secret) is redacted; a ?token= bootstrap URL is logged as sent. server_deps.dart.
securityHeadersMiddleware · directly inside logRequests, so it sets headers on every response, including auth refusals
CSP hashes the one inline theme script; Cache-Control no-store unless already set; HSTS when gateway.hsts is on. auth/security_headers.dart.
_corsMiddleware · only http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 origins are answered; any other origin gets Allow-Origin http://localhost
OPTIONS is answered directly, before authentication. server.dart.
authMiddleware · stateless: cookies are HMAC-signed with the gateway token, so dartclaw token rotate invalidates every one
With auth_mode: none every request gets local-admin context and originHostGuardMiddleware then needs a loopback server.host and Host.
originHostGuardMiddleware · cookie-authenticated POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE get 403 on a mismatch or when both headers are absent
Safe methods and Bearer requests are exempt; no-auth writes also need a loopback server.host and Host. origin_host_guard.dart.
router · routes mount under the pipeline; unmatched requests fall through a Cascade to the 404 page
Auth-exempt routes (/health, /login, /static, webhooks, /mcp) are decided by authMiddleware, not by the router.
plus /mcp and webhook paths when mounted
public path · the first check: a public path goes straight to the handler with no auth context
Slack, Google Chat and GitHub webhook paths are public only when their handler exists. server.dart _buildPipeline.
session cookie · a valid cookie resets the remote key on AuthRateLimiter and passes with cookie context
base64url({iat}).base64url(HMAC-SHA256(payload, gateway token)); no server-side state. auth/session_token.dart.
Authorization: Bearer · the gateway token as a Bearer passes with admin context and resets the failure window
32 Random.secure() bytes as 64 hex characters in <data_dir>/gateway_token, chmod 600; a blank token is rejected. auth/token_service.dart.
redirect to the URL without the token
GET ?token= · the bootstrap: any GET with a valid ?token= sets the session cookie and redirects with the token stripped
The token appears in the URL once; the serve banner prints it when stderr is a terminal, so rotate after sharing one. ADR-006.
otherwise · recordFailedAuth fires FailedAuthEvent and counts a failure for the remote key; a request over budget is not counted again
The credential checks run first, so a valid credential still passes while the key is over budget. auth_middleware.dart.
/mcp · resolved without short-circuiting, in constant time; the body is capped at 1 MiB
Only a gateway-token success resets the shared failure window, so the least-trusted credential cannot disable the limiter. mcp/mcp_router.dart.
webhooks · each route verifies itself, so a new route under /webhook/ must bring its own check
Slack also checks a 300 s replay window and audits refusals; a failed verification fires FailedAuthEvent but no throttle applies.
/knowledge/source · GET /knowledge/source?t=<token>: an exact auth-exempt path serving wiki pages and graph facts only
Every refusal is the wiki view's single 404; a missing or invalid token is a failed auth, and a valid link never counts or resets.
5 failures per minute per remote key
AuthRateLimiter · one instance in Server shared by the gateway, /mcp and /knowledge/source; success on the gateway resets the key
recordFailure appends a timestamp; shouldLimit prunes the window first, then answers 429. auth/auth_rate_limiter.dart.
